kurals.tr: Valiyaarkku Maaretral Ompuka Ompaa / Meliyaarmel Meka Pakai
kurals.m: Avoid offering resistance to the strong; (but) never fail to cherish enmity towards the weak

kurals.tr: Anpilan Aandra Thunaiyilan Thaandhuvvaan / Enpariyum Edhilaan Thuppu
kurals.m: How can he who is unloving, destitute of powerful aids, and himself without strength overcome the might of his foe ?

kurals.tr: Anjum Ariyaan Amaivilan Eekalaan / Thanjam Eliyan Pakaikku
kurals.m: In the estimation of foes miserably weak is he, who is timid, ignorant, unsociable and niggardly

kurals.tr: Neengaan Vekuli Niraiyilan Egngnaandrum / Yaanganum Yaarkkum Elidhu
kurals.m: He who neither refrains from anger nor keeps his secrets will at all times and in all places be easily conquered by all

kurals.tr: Vazhinokkaan Vaaippana Seyyaan Pazhinokkaan / Panpilan Patraarkku Inidhu
kurals.m: (A) pleasing (object) to his foes is he who reads not moral works, does nothing that is enjoined by them cares not for reproach and is not possessed of good qualities

kurals.tr: Kaanaach Chinaththaan Kazhiperung Kaamaththaan / Penaamai Penap Patum
kurals.m: Highly to be desired is the hatred of him whose anger is blind, and whose lust increases beyond measure

kurals.tr: Kotuththum Kolalventum Mandra Atuththirundhu / Maanaadha Seyvaan Pakai
kurals.m: It is indeed necessary to obtain even by purchase the hatred of him who having begun (a work) does what is not conductive (to its accomplishment)

kurals.tr: Kunanilanaaik Kutram Palavaayin Maatraarkku / Inanilanaam Emaap Putaiththu
kurals.m: He will become friendless who is without (any good) qualities and whose faults are many; (such a character) is a help to (his) foes

kurals.tr: Seruvaarkkuch Chenikavaa Inpam Arivilaa / Anjum Pakaivarp Perin
kurals.m: There will be no end of lofty delights to the victorious, if their foes are (both) ignorant and timid

kurals.tr: Kallaan Vekulum Siruporul Egngnaandrum / Ollaanai Ollaa Tholi
kurals.m: The light (of fame) will never be gained by him who gains not the trifling reputation of having fought an unlearned (foe)
